title: Today
description: Today is the running page for your day: your ;todo captures, the links you copy, and anything you add. Press ⌘T or click Today in the footer's left corner, or type ` on the empty input.

examples.note: Opens Today from the empty input

hint: captures a todo, note, or link
title: Capture without leaving
description: Start with ; and a target, then just keep typing. #tags, due: dates, and p1–p4 priority are read straight out of the sentence, so there's no form to fill in.

examples.note: A task on Today, due Friday
Type ; alone to pick from every capture target

title: Notes
description: Every note and day page opens in one editor that fills the window. Type # to start a note, link notes with [[Note title]], and pin the ones you use most so they come first. ↵ opens the Notes list.

examples.note: Starts a note titled with the time; type to rename it
In a note: pin, link, duplicate, or trash it

title: Past chats
description: Every chat with the model is kept. Open Agent Chat History to pick one up where you left off.

title: Talk instead of type
description: Hold {dictationHotkey} in any app and talk; let go and your words are typed where your cursor was. A quick tap listens until you tap again. Everything you said is kept in Dictation History.

examples.note: Tap to start, tap again to stop

title: What ran
description: The line above the input shows the last thing that ran. Press ↑ on the empty input to put it back in play: run it again, undo it, or share it. What You Ran Today lists everything from today.

title: Use what's focused
description: The chip at the right of the input names what's focused: the front app's window, or text you selected. Press Space on the empty input to put it in play, then pick what to do with it.

examples.note: Stages the front window or your selected text

title: Say what should happen
description: Type a sentence instead of a command name. Jev reads it against what's on screen and lists up to three ways to do it under JEV. ⌘1–3 runs one; ⌘↵ runs the first.

examples.input: turn on do not disturb for an hour
examples.note: Jev's readings fill the rows under JEV

title: Chat with the model
description: With nothing typed, ⌘↵ opens a chat with the model under the input. With words typed, ⌘↵ runs Jev's first reading. To ask about a row, press ⌘K on it and pick "Ask the model about it".

examples.note: On a row: "Ask the model about it"

title: Quick question
description: Tap {mainHotkey} twice from anywhere to ask the model a quick question, with nothing attached.

title: Copy a link, keep it
description: Links you copy are added to Today on their own, so you can find them later without saving anything.

examples.note: Copy a link anywhere; it shows up on Today

title: Mention context
description: Type @ to pull files, clipboard entries, notes, calendar events, and more into what you're asking. Add a source and a colon to search only that source.

examples.note: Picks a calendar event as context

title: Commands for text
description: Type / for commands that work on text: rewrite, summarize, explain, fix, translate, and review. Keep typing to narrow the list.

title: Filter with key:value
description: Put a key:value anywhere in your search to narrow the list. Filters combine with plain words.

examples.note: Only items with a keyboard shortcut

title: Browse files
description: Type ~ on the empty input to browse your home folder. Keep typing a path to drill in.

title: Quick terminal
description: Type ! on the empty input to open a terminal right in the window.

title: Actions
description: Press ⌘K to see everything you can do with the focused row. Type to filter the actions, ↵ to run one.

examples.note: Lists actions for the focused row
Lets go; the list comes back as it was

hint: Typing searches scripts, notes, chats, clipboard, history
title: One search, every source
description: Plain typing searches scripts, flows, notes, past chats, clipboard history, Chrome tabs, and browser history together.

examples.note: Scripts, notes, and history in one list
Clipboard matches right beside your scripts

title: Help
description: Type ? on the empty input to come back here. Search by key or by word, and press ↵ on anything to try it.
